title: epan: Use unsigned offsets for the tvb_get_ accessors
description:
We have to check for overflow now in fast_ensure_contiguous.
Previously a positive int plus no more than 8 never overflowed
an unsigned; on the other hand the DISSECTOR_ASSERT and test for
negative offset may have outweighed the savings.

Ping #20103
